name: vr-creative-sandbox
description: Physics-real VR creative sandbox (WebXR, Quest 3S target, desktop fallback)

scripts.test: node tools/verdict.mjs TEST --ran node_modules/.verdict-test.json vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=node_modules/.verdict-test.json
scripts.tidy: node tools/verdict.mjs TIDY --ran node_modules/.verdict-tidy.json vitest run tests/nexus/tidy.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=node_modules/.verdict-tidy.json
scripts.gate: node tools/verdict.mjs GATE --ran node_modules/.verdict-gate.json tsc --noEmit -p . -- vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=node_modules/.verdict-gate.json
scripts.nexus: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/nexus.mjs
scripts.nexus:round: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/round.mjs
scripts.nexus:scene: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/scene.mjs
scripts.nexus:census: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/census.mjs
scripts.nexus:view: npm run nexus:scene && vite build --config vite.view.config.ts --logLevel error
scripts.invent: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/invent.mjs
scripts.breakdown: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/breakdown.mjs
scripts.pack: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/pack.mjs
scripts.boardmap: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/boardmap.mjs
scripts.works: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/works.mjs
scripts.machine: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/machine.mjs
scripts.plan: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/plan.mjs
scripts.part: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/part.mjs
scripts.why: vite build --config vite.nexus.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-nexus/why.mjs
scripts.quick: node tools/verdict.mjs QUICK --ran node_modules/.verdict-quick.json tsc --noEmit -p . -- vitest run tests/nexus/tidy.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=node_modules/.verdict-quick.json -- vitest run --changed HEAD
